notes: Counts per wreck: 7+7+7+9+10+10+11 = 61 regular chests, plus 7 secret chests = 68. So items here are 7 wrecks, not 68 individual chests. Chests show a white dot when holding L2/LT and nearby ones are marked on the map. Air barrels or pockets restore breath; for sharks, dodge sideways when a white glint shows on the mouth.
